concepts.title: 线性方程组与解的分类
concepts.summary: 解必须同时满足所有原方程。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用代入、消元或行化简。出现 $0=c\ne0$ 则无解；无矛盾且有自由变量则无穷多解。

en.title: Linear systems and solution types
en.summary: A solution must satisfy every original equation.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use substitution, elimination, or row reduction. A row $0=c\ne0$ means no solution; consistency with a free variable means infinitely many solutions.

concepts.title: 非线性方程组与实数限制
concepts.summary: 消元后列出全部候选，再回代。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 把一式代入另一式，分解或解二次方程。平方、除法和实际情境都可能限制候选。

en.title: Nonlinear systems and real restrictions
en.summary: Eliminate, list all candidates, then substitute back.

method.title: Method
method.body: Substitute into the other equation, factor or solve the quadratic, and check restrictions from squaring, division, and context.

concepts.title: 不等式组与线性规划
concepts.summary: 可行域是所有条件的交集。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 非严格边界画实线，严格边界画虚线；最优化要检查可行顶点及无界方向。

en.title: Inequality systems and linear programming
en.summary: The feasible set is the intersection of all constraints.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use solid boundaries for nonstrict inequalities and dashed boundaries for strict ones. Optimization checks feasible vertices and unbounded directions.

concepts.title: 矩阵运算与行化简
concepts.summary: 相加同型，相乘内维相同，乘法顺序不可交换。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $(AB)_{ij}=\sum_k a_{ik}b_{kj}$。初等行变换保持方程组解集；求阶梯形与最简阶梯形时逐列选择主元。

en.title: Matrix operations and row reduction
en.summary: Addition requires equal shapes; multiplication requires matching inner dimensions and is ordered.

method.title: Method
method.body: $(AB)_{ij}=\sum_k a_{ik}b_{kj}$. Elementary row operations preserve a linear system. Select pivots column by column for echelon and reduced echelon forms.

concepts.title: 行列式与克拉默法则
concepts.summary: 只有方阵有行列式；克拉默商要求分母非零。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $2\times2$ 行列式为 $ad-bc$；一般按代数余子式展开。$D\ne0$ 时 $x_i=D_i/D$；$D=0$ 须再看秩与增广矩阵。

en.title: Determinants and Cramer’s rule
en.summary: Only square matrices have determinants; Cramer quotients require a nonzero denominator.

method.title: Method
method.body: A $2\times2$ determinant is $ad-bc$; expand larger ones by cofactors. If $D\ne0$, $x_i=D_i/D$; if $D=0$, examine ranks and the augmented matrix.

concepts.title: 部分分式与原定义域
concepts.summary: 先判断真分式，再按因子及重数列项。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 重复线性因子各次幂都要有常数分子；不可约二次因子的分子为一次式。通分比较系数，结果只在原定义域相等。

en.title: Partial fractions and the original domain
en.summary: Check properness, then include every factor power.

method.title: Method
method.body: Include a constant numerator at every power of a repeated linear factor and a linear numerator for each irreducible quadratic power. Recombine and compare coefficients; retain the original domain.

method.title: 方法
method.body: $A$ 为方阵且 $\det A\ne0$ 才可逆。$[A\mid I]$ 行化简为 $[I\mid A^{-1}]$，乘回两侧检验。

method.title: Method
method.body: A square matrix is invertible exactly when $\det A\ne0$. Row-reduce $[A\mid I]$ to $[I\mid A^{-1}]$ and verify both products.

exercises.prompt: 求部分分式分解：$\frac{x + 3}{\left(x - 7\right) \left(x + 4\right)^{2}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分母因式分解为 $\left(x - 7\right) \left(x + 4\right)^{2}$，保留原定义域：$x\ne -4,7$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 按各因子和重数设 $\frac{a_{1}}{x - 7} + \frac{a_{2}}{x + 4} + \frac{a_{3}}{\left(x + 4\right)^{2}}$；所有系数暂未知。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 通分后的分子为 $x + 3$，与原分子 $x + 3$ 相同，所以原定义域内恒等。

en.prompt: Find the partial-fraction decomposition: $\frac{x + 3}{\left(x - 7\right) \left(x + 4\right)^{2}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Factor the denominator as $\left(x - 7\right) \left(x + 4\right)^{2}$ and retain the original domain: $x\ne -4,7$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Set the factor-by-factor form $\frac{a_{1}}{x - 7} + \frac{a_{2}}{x + 4} + \frac{a_{3}}{\left(x + 4\right)^{2}}$, with undetermined coefficients.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Multiply by the original denominator and equate coefficients: $- a_{1} - a_{2}=0,\ - 8 a_{1} + 3 a_{2} - a_{3} + 1=0,\ - 16 a_{1} + 28 a_{2} + 7 a_{3} + 3=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Solve the coefficient equations: $a_{1}=\frac{10}{121},\ a_{2}=- \frac{10}{121},\ a_{3}=\frac{1}{11}$. Substitute to obtain $- \frac{10}{121 \left(x + 4\right)} + \frac{1}{11 \left(x + 4\right)^{2}} + \frac{10}{121 \left(x - 7\right)}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Recombination gives numerator $x + 3$, equal to the original $x + 3$, proving the identity on the original domain.
